# Command catalog

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:generate from dist/js/commands.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

All 53 commands in catalog order. Names, categories, cmdlets, and descriptions come directly from the catalog.

| Action | Category | Main cmdlets | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Get computer information | System Information | `Get-ComputerInfo` | A snapshot of the operating system, hardware, and Windows version. |
| Check disk space | System Information | `Get-CimInstance` | See capacity and free space for every local fixed drive. |
| List running processes | Processes | `Get-Process` | Find running processes and their current memory usage. |
| Get Windows services | Windows Services | `Get-Service` | List installed services with their names and current status. |
| Restart a Windows service | Windows Services | `Get-Service`, `Restart-Service`, `Invoke-Command` | Restart a named service, with an optional remote computer. |
| List files in a directory | File Management | `Get-ChildItem` | Explore files in a folder, optionally including subfolders. |
| Find older files | File Management | `Get-ChildItem`, `Where-Object` | Find files that have not been modified for a number of days. |
| Test network connectivity | Networking | `Test-Connection` | Send a small set of ping requests to a hostname or IP address. |
| Read recent event logs | Event Logs | `Get-WinEvent` | Review a bounded set of recent Windows events without changing logs. |
| List scheduled tasks | Scheduled Tasks | `Get-ScheduledTask` | Inspect registered tasks and their current state without starting them. |
| List installed software | System Information | `Get-ItemProperty` | Inventory desktop software registered for this machine and the current user. |
| Look up DNS records | Networking | `Resolve-DnsName` | Resolve a hostname using the default or a specified DNS server. |
| Test a TCP port | Networking | `Test-NetConnection` | Check whether a host accepts a connection on a selected TCP port. |
| List TCP connections | Networking | `Get-NetTCPConnection` | Inspect local TCP endpoints, remote peers, and owning process IDs. |
| Get Active Directory user | Active Directory | `Get-ADUser` | Look up one user by account name or distinguished name. |
| List Active Directory computers | Active Directory | `Get-ADComputer` | Inventory domain computers and their operating systems. |
| List Active Directory groups | Active Directory | `Get-ADGroup` | Browse groups and their category, scope, and location. |
| Get Active Directory group members | Active Directory | `Get-ADGroupMember` | List direct members, or expand nested group membership. |
| Find locked Active Directory users | Active Directory | `Search-ADAccount` | Report locked user accounts without unlocking them. |
| Find inactive Active Directory users | Active Directory | `Search-ADAccount` | Review accounts with no recent directory logon activity. |
| Get IP configuration | Networking | `Get-NetIPConfiguration` | Inspect local adapter addresses and gateways. |
| List network adapters | Networking | `Get-NetAdapter` | Check local adapter status and link speed. |
| Get DNS server settings | Networking | `Get-DnsClientServerAddress` | See the DNS servers configured on local interfaces. |
| Read folder permissions | File Management | `Get-Acl` | Show ownership and individual access rules. This is not an effective-access calculation. |
| Check file integrity | File Management | `Get-FileHash` | Compute a file hash and optionally compare it to an expected value. |
| List local group members | System Information | `Get-LocalGroupMember` | Inspect membership of a local Windows group. |
| Check BitLocker status | System Information | `Get-BitLockerVolume` | Read volume protection and encryption status without exposing recovery protectors. |
| Check Microsoft Defender status | System Information | `Get-MpComputerStatus` | Read Defender-reported protection and signature state. |
| Look up installed hotfixes | System Information | `Get-HotFix` | List CBS-reported hotfixes or check one KB identifier. |
| Inspect service configuration | Windows Services | `Get-CimInstance` | Read service status, startup mode, and account on the local computer. |
| Who is signed in | Security | `Get-Date`, `quser` | Query interactive user sessions with quser. Remote queries require the relevant session permissions; output is localized text. |
| Start a stopped service | Windows Services | `Start-Service`, `Get-Service` | Start an explicitly chosen service or names from an earlier services result, then read back status. |
| Last reboot and uptime | System Information | `Get-CimInstance` | Report the last boot time and elapsed uptime in hours. |
| Check for pending reboot | System Information | `Get-ItemProperty`, `Test-Path` | Inspect CBS, Windows Update and pending file rename indicators. These indicators are evidence, not an exhaustive reboot assessment. |
| Check physical disk health | System Information | `Get-PhysicalDisk` | Inspect storage-provider health and operational status; controller support varies. |
| Find automatic services that are stopped | Windows Services | `Get-CimInstance` | List automatic services that are not running. Optionally ignore the first ten minutes after boot to reduce delayed-start false positives. |
| Errors in the last N hours | Event Logs | `Get-WinEvent` | Review critical and error events in System and Application logs. |
| Unexpected shutdowns and restarts | Event Logs | `Get-WinEvent` | Inspect Kernel-Power 41, unexpected shutdown 6008 and planned restart 1074. |
| Failed sign-ins | Event Logs | `Get-WinEvent` | Inspect Security event 4625. Audit policy must record failed logons; message contains account and source details. |
| Find cleared event logs | Event Logs | `Get-WinEvent` | Inspect Security 1102 and System 104 for evidence that logs were cleared. |
| Find account lockout sources | Active Directory | `Get-WinEvent` | Query Security 4740 on the chosen PDC emulator and show CallerComputerName. Unlocking without fixing the source can lock the account again. |
| What is listening on this port | Networking | `Get-NetTCPConnection`, `Get-Process` | Join listening TCP endpoints with their owning process names. |
| Find expiring certificates | Security | `Get-ChildItem` | Inspect LocalMachine My certificates expiring within N days, including already expired certificates. No private keys are exported. |
| Find largest files | File Management | `Get-ChildItem` | Rank files by size beneath a chosen folder. Traversal can take time on large trees. |
| Find failing scheduled tasks | Scheduled Tasks | `Get-ScheduledTask`, `Get-ScheduledTaskInfo` | Inspect last task results; exclude success, currently running (0x41301) and not yet run (0x41303). |
| Check PowerShell remoting | Networking | `Test-WSMan` | Probe WinRM with Test-WSMan. A response does not guarantee your account can open a remote session. |
| Inspect routes and default gateway | Networking | `Get-NetRoute` | Inspect IPv4 routes and gateway next hops. |
| Check time sync status | System Information | `Get-Date`, `w32tm` | Query Windows Time service status. Clock drift can break authentication; compare the reported source and offset. |
| Get AD password expiry date | Active Directory | `Get-ADUser` | Convert the computed AD password expiry file time. Never-expiring and unavailable values are labeled. |
| Unlock an Active Directory account | Active Directory | `Unlock-ADAccount`, `Get-ADUser` | Unlock one explicitly chosen account, then read back LockedOut. Preview and confirmation are supported. |
| Create a workstation restore point | System Information | `Checkpoint-Computer` | Create a client Windows restore point. System Restore must be enabled; Windows normally limits creation to one point per 24 hours. |
| Filter to reachable hosts | Networking | `Test-Connection` | Check a comma-separated list of hosts with one ping each. ICMP failure can mean filtering; it does not prove a host is down. |
| Export combined workflow report | Reports | `ConvertTo-Json`, `Export-Csv`, `ConvertTo-Html` | Combine earlier captured results into a report. HTML encodes result data; CSV uses a consistent Step, Target, Data envelope. |
